items.headline: OpenAI to respect a shared robots.txt signal
items.summary: OpenAI will honour a shared robots.txt signal that lets website operators convey their AI training preferences to participating providers.
items.why_it_matters: Provides a standard way for sites to control AI data usage.

items.headline: OpenAI adds stronger violence safeguards to ChatGPT
items.summary: OpenAI is expanding ChatGPT’s violence‑prevention safeguards, introducing earlier interventions and a new public safety reporting commitment.
items.why_it_matters: Aims to reduce harmful content generated by the model.

items.headline: Exploit found in ChatGPT’s HTML preview sandbox
items.summary: Parameter Labs discovered an attack chain where untrusted code in a sandboxed iframe could use postMessage and innerHTML to inject HTML into the parent page, bypassing restrictions.
items.why_it_matters: Highlights risks of insufficient sandbox isolation in AI‑driven interfaces.

items.headline: Meta’s Muse Charm AI device likened to a Tamagotchi
items.summary: Meta introduced the Muse Charm, a small AI‑enabled device with a cute face intended to be carried like a Tamagotchi.
items.why_it_matters: Shows consumer‑focused hardware attempts to personalise AI interaction.

items.headline: Privacy‑focused AI assistant Ollie to shut down
items.summary: The founder of Ollie announced the privacy‑centred AI assistant will cease operations within a week as the market becomes crowded.
items.why_it_matters: Removes a privacy‑oriented option from the growing AI assistant landscape.

items.headline: Apple Intelligence to arrive in China with iOS 27.3
items.summary: Apple will roll out Apple Intelligence in China via an iOS 27.3 beta on 4 November, with a full release slated for December.
items.why_it_matters: Expands Apple’s AI features to the Chinese market.
